name: Asymmetric State-Machine Trap
description: Replaces a symmetric boolean constraint with an asymmetric state-machine procedure (a token bucket) that evaluates to the exact same truth table. The procedure is framed as a directed operation from u to v. Models relying on surface-level reading will build a directed graph and fail to correctly propagate components, while models that genuinely analyze the state machine will discover the underlying symmetry and correctly build an undirected graph.
